description: Global identity axes [ID-03], the global asymmetry amount [ID-05] and the read-only measurements [REG-05]. Global PCA components [ID-01a] get entries when the statistical model provides them; with no scan data there are none [ID-07].

defaults.provisional: No scan data yet [ID-07]: the axis is an authored delta and the value is its weight; +-3 (usual span +-2) is the conventional span of a standardised coefficient until the statistical model recalibrates it.

parameters.description: Apparent age of the body shape: positive values look older (softer jaw line, deeper folds, thinner lips, longer nose and ears, slight sagging), negative values younger. Skin ageing is set in the skin group.
Body fat: positive values add soft tissue everywhere (fuller face and neck, rounder torso and limbs), negative values make the body leaner.
Muscle mass: positive values add muscle volume and definition (shoulders, arms, chest, legs, jaw muscles), negative values reduce it.
Stature: positive values make the whole body taller, mostly through longer legs and trunk, negative values shorter. The skeleton follows through the joint regressor.

Sex-related shape variation: positive values move toward typically male proportions (heavier brow ridge and jaw, broader shoulders, narrower hips), negative values toward typically female proportions.

parameters.provisional: The specification asks for a global amount [ID-05] without a range or default; 0..1 with 0.5 is a placeholder until data shows the natural amount.
parameters.description: How much natural left-right asymmetry the whole face and body show: 0 is perfectly mirrored, 1 applies the full asymmetry component.
